method: Complete Capstone disassembly of every reviewed function (function-start to function-start via kc_image.function_starts)

TXM request layout decoded on-stack: +0x00 u32 selector, +0x06 u8 failure_fatal, +0x08 u8 skip_logs, +0x0c u32 num_input_args, +0x10 u32 num_output_args, +0x14 txm_ret (u16 code @ +0x14, u16 errno @ +0x18 when code == protocol-errno marker)
AppleImage4 kext auth-GOT slots decoded (tagged pointer = kc_base + (qword & 0x3fffffff)) and stub->slot->target chains resolved
Kext call-site register setup and all referenced cstrings extracted

Compared against xnu source: bsd/kern/kern_codesigning.c, bsd/kern/code_signing/txm.c, EXTERNAL_HEADERS/image4/cs/traps.h, libkern/libkern/image4/{api,dlxk,interface}.h, libkern/libkern/img4/interface.h, EXTERNAL_HEADERS/img4/runtime.h

txm_call_core.identity: txm_kernel_call core dispatcher (per-cpu TXM call-frame pool at 0x7c7b428-adjacent globals; packs up to 8 input args by num_input_args, executes call, writes ret+errno into req+0x14)
txm_call_core.verdict: verified-shape (all Image4 wrappers funnel here; same body as used by selectors 0x1c,0x2d-0x37)

alloc.contract: f(len): NULL len -> panic (assert @0x7093478 line 0x46); len+0x3fff overflow -> panic (@0x70b8200 line 0x1dd); else page-rounds to 16K and allocs via 0xa2b7bd8 (kmem-style alloc, flags 0x4180/0x17); returns zeroed TXM-sharable buffer or NULL

functions.signature: errno_t kernel_image4_monitor_trap(image4_cs_trap_t selector, const void *input_data, size_t input_size, void *output_data, size_t *output_size)

argument_registers.x3,x4: output_data, output_size - present in signature per source, unused by body

functions.return: errno_t in w0: 0 success; 22 (EINVAL) on NULL input, zero size, or vector-size mismatch; 78 (ENOSYS) for reserved selectors 1 and 2; 1 (EPERM) when TXM ret code != 5; otherwise the monitor-supplied errno; 1 also when a TXM staging buffer cannot be allocated
body: if (x1+x2 overflows) -> panic @0x709367c 'image4_ dispatch: overflow on input: %p | %lu' (src line 0x70c)
img4if = *(0x7c3b028); if img4if NULL -> vector_size=-1 else vector_size = blraa [img4if+0xf8](selector) [image4_cs_trap_vector_size, PAC discr x17=0xba5]

selector==5 (IMAGE4_CS_TRAP_IMAGE_ACTIVATE): copies 32-byte argv into sp+0x30; w21=payload_len@+0x10? (struct field at argv+0x10 used as len; src ptr argv+0x8), w22=manifest_len@argv+0x1c, manifest src argv+0x14; allocates two TXM buffers via 0xa737db0, memcpy 0xaa3eeb0, registers via 0xa739dc8, rewrites argv pointers to staged buffers, calls 0xa73b754(5, &argv, 0x20); on failure unregisters/frees via 0xa739eac+0xa737e44
functions.evidence: Exact match to kern_codesigning.c kernel_image4_monitor_trap + _kernel_image4_monitor_trap_image_activate: EINVAL(22) constants, selector<3 reserved ENOSYS(78), cs_trap_vector_size at img4 interface offset +0xf8 (dlxk field cs_trap_vector_size), selector-5 payload/manifest staging, panic strings. Fixture label _kernel_image4_copy_object is WRONG; copy_object is the ENOSYS stub pair (see 0xa739194/0xa73919c).

functions.signature: errno_t f(image4_cs_trap_t selector, const void *input_data, size_t input_size)
functions.body: txm_call {selector=0x2d (kTXMKernelSelectorImage4Dispatch), num_input_args=5} args=(selector, input_data, input_size, NULL, NULL) via 0xa739590; on call failure: if txm_ret==5 use u32 errno at req+0x18 (errno==0 -> panic @0x7093927 'image4_ dispatch: %llu returned no error'-style, src line 0x742); else return 1 (EPERM). Matches txm.c txm_image4_monitor_trap exactly.

functions.verdict: identity-by-semantics; source-level name unresolved (function absent from xnu-12377 kern_codesigning.c; real execute_object returns ENOSYS, see 0xa739194)
functions.signature: errno_t f(uint32_t /* or u64 */ domain_or_type, const void *nonce_digest_struct, uint64_t len_or_handle)
functions.return: errno_t: 0 on success; on TXM failure returns req+0x18 u16 errno when txm_ret code==0x2b else 0xffff
consumer_evidence: com.apple.security.Image4 auth-GOT slot 0xfffffff0080d1a58 -> 0xa739468; call stub 0xfffffff009ef4a98; single call site 0xfffffff009ee3a44 inside kext fn 0x9ee38fc

fn 0x9ee38fc is the nonce-'magazine' init path: acquires mix-and-match status (0x9ef0250), initializes nonce slots (0x9ef0554), resolves signing authority (0x9ef068c), then iterates the slot array (stride 0x78) under lock @0xafd2ec8

per slot: helper 0x9ef0d84/0x9ef2200 queries the ApBootNonce digest from AppleImage4 and writes a 0x38-byte struct {u8 digest[48]; u64 len=0x30} at sp+0x10; on failure logs 'Image4: unable to get nonce digest for slot: %u | %u'
on success calls wrapper(x0 = slot->+0x14 u32 domain/type id, x1 = &digest_struct, x2 = *(struct+0x30) i.e. 48/len-or-handle) -> selector 0x34 sends (domain, digest ptr, third scalar) to the monitor
paired with PPL-side panic strings 'Image4: attempted to set nonce digest again: %u', 'invalid nonce type for setting digest', 'nonce digest too large for PPL' (kext fns 0x9ee6f54)
functions.semantic: v2 monitor-side equivalent of set_nonce: commits the per-domain 48-byte ApBootNonce digest into the code-signing monitor. NOT execute_object (execute_object has no live TXM implementation - ENOSYS).

consumer_evidence: com.apple.security.Image4 auth-GOT slot 0xfffffff0080d1a50 -> 0xa7394e0; stub 0xfffffff009ef4a88; single call site 0xfffffff009ee3f34 inside kext fn 0x9ee3edc
fn 0x9ee3edc is external-method-table entry index 4 (table @0x80cf588+, entry {fn, scalarIn=1, structIn=0, scalarOut=1, structOut=0}); reads u32 scalarInput[0] = domain id

paired with PPL-side panic 'Image4: attempted to roll nonce without PPL context/mutable buffer' (fn 0x9ee705c)
functions.semantic: v2 monitor-side nonce roll. Fixture name roll_nonce is semantically consistent but the ABI differs from the old kernel_image4_roll_nonce(ndi): arg is a domain index, return is errno_t.

consumer_evidence: com.apple.security.Image4 auth-GOT slot 0xfffffff0080d1a40 -> 0xa73954c; stub 0xfffffff009ef4978; single call site 0xfffffff009ee4180 inside Image4UserClient::objectLoad (fn 0x9ee3f48, external-method index 5, structInputSize=0x28)
input struct: {u32 type@0, user manifest ptr@8, manifest len@0x10, user payload ptr@0x18, payload len@0x20}; kernel copyin of both buffers

type 0 path only: checks entitlement 'com.apple.private.img4.set-supplemental-root', executes supplemental root in kext expert (0x9eec6a4, failure -> 'Image4: unable to load Diavlo Root CA: %u'), queries monitor capability via kernel 0xa737f4c(out u32==2), then calls wrapper(manifest, manifest_len, payload, payload_len)
wrapper failure -> panic 'Image4: failed to load Diavlo Root CA with code-signing-monitor: %u' (fn 0x9ef27f8); success -> 'Image4: successfully loaded Diavlo Root CA on the system'
functions.semantic: pushes the supplemental-software trust root (Diavlo Root CA object spec, IMG4_RUNTIME_OBJECT_SPEC_SUPPLEMENTAL_ROOT; 'object can only be executed once per boot' per img4/runtime.h) into the code-signing monitor after kext-side execution.

Callers pass (u32*, u32*); objectLoad uses only the first out (=2).
